generation: Generation 2 — Capability Architecture & Symbiotic Platform Engineering

research.saturation_rule: A capability is SATURATED only after principal representatives are covered and two consecutive revisits produce no material new architectural finding, or remaining questions require repository validation rather than external research.
research.candidate_inventory_authority: project_docs/generation-2/research/CAPABILITY_DISCOVERY_REGISTER.md plus prior state history and capability dossiers; compact representations do not revoke prior candidates
research.historical_coverage_authority: project_docs/generation-2/research/REPRESENTATIVE_COVERAGE.md and capability dossiers; all prior coverage remains authoritative and unsuperseded
research.finding_inventory_authority: project_docs/generation-2/research/FINDING_INDEX.md plus capability dossiers and prior state history; compact state does not revoke prior findings

Adaptive Governed Work Surfaces.required_boundary: Enterprise → Station → Role → Person; higher invariants non-weakenable; Station is first-class capability-exposure/delegated-administration/hierarchical-SB boundary.
Adaptive Governed Work Surfaces.required_authoring_rule: Users express intent and compose constrained semantic components; AI is sole materializer over valid entities/domains/capabilities/permissions/contracts and must classify mutation authority and escalate canonical domain/process changes.
required_proofs: AI request requiring domain change escalated

enterprise_completeness_negative_space_g.rule: CAPABILITY_SYNTHESIS remains blocked after cycle 7 until enterprise archetypes and negative-space concerns are classified, material semantic-owner gaps are researched or explicitly deferred with rationale, and no material category remains ownerless. Commercial metering/entitlements/rating/billing/payment and relative operational complexity pricing must be explicitly challenged as part of cost/quotas/metering/FinOps negative space if not promoted/researched earlier.

gates.RESEARCH_ELICITATION: All active macro-capabilities have representative coverage, discovered candidates are triaged, minimum cycles completed, saturation conditions are satisfied, and when completed_full_cycles >= 7 the Enterprise Completeness / Negative-Space Review gate is closed with no material ownerless category.
gates.ENTERPRISE_COMPLETENESS_NEGATIVE_SPACE_R: Mandatory after completed_full_cycles >= 7 and before CAPABILITY_SYNTHESIS.
gates.CAPABILITY_SYNTHESIS: Canonical taxonomy, subcapabilities, cross-cutting capabilities, representative coverage, recurring primitives and unresolved contradictions consolidated.
gates.PLANNING_A_TAXONOMY_BOUNDARIES: Ownership, boundaries, overlap rules and non-goals explicit.
gates.PLANNING_B_SB_CURRENT_STATE_RECONCILIATI: Each material capability mapped to fresh-main repository truth, contracts, tests, maturity and gaps.
gates.PLANNING_C_TARGET_ARCHITECTURE: Target planes, primitives, provider/binding model, portable definition/IR and evidence/provenance coherent and decision-backed.
gates.PLANNING_D_DEPENDENCY_MIGRATION_STRATEGY: Dependency order, compatibility, migration, rollback and coexistence explicit.
gates.ARCHITECTURE_RECONCILIATION: Each material finding/gap has evidence-backed disposition and dependencies.
gates.WBS_DECOMPOSITION: Reconciled architecture decisions decomposed into bounded WBS documents.
gates.WBS_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH: Cross-WBS graph acyclic or explicitly staged.
gates.WORK_PACKAGE_DESIGN: WPs derived from WBS and sized for 3–10 Construction Sprints plus required gates.
gates.READY_FOR_WORKER_HANDOFF: Research/planning complete, integrated and ready for separate :10/:30/:50 execution pipeline.

current_focus: Integration & Automation — revisit 3 / cycle 4 complete. Six material findings establish trigger/subscription vs delivery-run revision coexistence; transport receipt distinct from domain acceptance; retry/redrive/replay lineage; governed integration migration; qualified local integration closure; and revision-bound Station authority attenuation across asynchronous continuation. No candidate was promoted.
